meta.title: What if the one annoying you is not a mirror? | Chant of the Mirror and the Face
meta.description:
A short chant for the middle of a conflict, when everything the other person does seems to be about you. It offers four lines and a simple practice: turn side by side, then look again.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and return to what went unsaid: look again at the one who keeps showing you yourself.

A four-line chant for conflict that asks whether you are seeing a face or a mirror, and if only yourself looks back, turns you side by side to look again.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/chants/chant-of-the-mirror-and-the-face
